name: mule-secure-properties
title: Mule Secure Properties
description: Encrypt and decrypt MuleSoft secure property values with the official Secure Properties Tool.
author: stiven_gonzalez

commands.name: encrypt
commands.title: Encrypt Property
commands.subtitle: MuleSoft
commands.description: Encrypt a string as a MuleSoft secure property value and copy it to the clipboard.

commands.name: decrypt
commands.title: Decrypt Property
commands.subtitle: MuleSoft
commands.description: Decrypt a MuleSoft secure property value and copy the plaintext to the clipboard.

preferences.name: defaultPassword
preferences.title: Default Password
preferences.description: Prefills the password field in Encrypt and Decrypt. Must match the key configured in your Mule app.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
